model_construction_order: 2. identify orphan source part (Part-1) and instance (Part-1-1)
3. record source model entities (materials, section, element types, sets, BCs)
4. create geometry-backed part with Part2DGeomFrom2DMesh(name='Part-1-GEOM', part=orphan_part)
5. assign section and material data to geometry-backed face geometry
7. seed and generate initial mesh on geometry-backed part
8. instantiate geometry-backed part as dependent assembly instance
9. preserve original instance name Part-1-1 (rename orphan instance to Part-1-1-ORPHAN)
10. rebuild required part and assembly sets/surfaces
11. rebuild or rebind loads, BCs, equations to geometry-backed sets
12. suppress or remove orphan-mesh assembly instance Part-1-1-ORPHAN
14. create explicit Region from geometry-backed faces
15. create MISESERI RemeshingRule on explicit face Region
17. permit Model.adaptiveRemesh(odb) only after audit pass
